rows.note: Use this as the straightforward everyday choice for being sick or medically unwell.
Use this all-purpose adjective for something unfavourable, poor, faulty, or generally not good.

example.english: This computer is ill; it keeps crashing.
example.traditional: 呢部電腦真係唔好，成日死機。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 nou5 zan1 hai6 m4 hou2 seng4 jat6 sei2 gei1

rows.note: Use this when the ill quality is specifically malicious, cruel, or poisonous in intent.

example.english: They made some remarks with ill intent.
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 di1 syut3 waa6 hou2 ok3 duk6

rows.note: Use this when someone feels nauseated or has an urge to vomit rather than simply being sick.

example.english: After eating this dish, I feel ill and nauseated.
example.traditional: 食完呢碟嘢，我有啲反胃。
example.jyutping: sik6 jyun4 ni1 dip6 je5 ngo5 jau5 di1 faan2 wai6
